The '''1958–59 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 28th since its establishment. The season began on 14 September 1958, and concluded on 19 April 1959.

==Competition format==
For this season, the [[La Liga play-offs|relegation play-offs]] were re-established. 13th and 14th qualified teams would play a double-legged playoff against the second qualified teams of the two groups of [[1958–59 Segunda División|Segunda División]].
